title: 第1003章 十七天级第1002章 水系大定
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
水系皇城，云帝嫔妃，原水星帝女水嫣然和水妍柔配合帝子云谕旨和水墨主宰口谕，以身作则领兵而去。
一众王公贵族有的也接旨带兵出战。
而一些王公贵族还幻想他们没有融合之前一手遮天，高高在上不劳而获夜夜笙歌朱门酒肉臭。一些老顽固逢场作戏，皮笑肉不笑；
“云帝带兵前来解救水星大陆，我等表示欢迎。然，云帝可知这里曾经是水星帝都，与龙汉帝国帝都平起平坐的存在。
尊称云帝，乃我等给予薄面，我等皆乃水星雄踞一方王公贵族霸主，自当坐镇皇宫关心天下苍生，天下不可没有运筹帷幄核心层。我等若是被强行差遣与魔拼杀，相信万族不允。”
帝子云剑眉紧皱又挑了挑，万族不允你们上阵杀敌？龙汉帝国当今主宰玄德大帝，以及与玄德大帝一般强大的原金星正弘主宰都在天外与最强魔神军以及逆神天庭伪神厮杀，尔能排在何位？
而本主的面子需要你给？帝子云没有回应，根本不想与贪生怕死之辈浪费口舌。这些坐享其成之辈若是遇上更强逆神天庭伪神，恐将瞬间跪伏。目光看向水墨主宰。水墨主宰心神领会，帝子云这是准备清理朝纲内部；
“水无影皇太宰，如今魔神军大军压境，或许以前皇太傅没有经历神劫有所不知。然，尔等只需知道覆巢之下无完卵，而你贵为新神，可知这些时日神级法力在缓慢衰退？
神劫便是化道神级，你战与不战逆神天庭伪神都会降临收割宇宙诸天万族，以便他们在神劫安然无恙渡劫。而你战还有一线希望，若是不与龙汉帝国同心抵御外敌，唯有视为逆反。”
水墨作为以前水星主宰，对很多王公贵族皆是睁只眼闭只眼。然，神劫来临，唯有乱世用重典，否则滋生蔓延歪门邪道。一部分看水墨力保帝子云威严，赶紧领旨匆匆离去。往刀口上撞乃愚夫所为。
然，还有许多仗着水墨一直以来以德服人，不会有过激之举，不为所动。而且对帝子云的恨意在眉宇间一闪而过。然他们的狼子野心自然逃不过帝子云和水墨主宰。
水墨主宰只觉得这些家伙严重挑衅她的威严，在龙汉天朝未来帝君云帝那里颜面无存。这些鱼肉百姓贪图享乐又贪生怕死之辈真乃水系败类。
真要让他们去天外与大神厮杀，必将调转矛头反杀人间，毕竟他们认为逆神天庭以及魔域才是不可战胜的大恐怖，而人间相对好欺辱。
“禁卫军执法队何在，将余下之人统统拉出斩首！”。用人之际，水墨主宰的威严却受到严重挑衅，请都请不动唯有使用重典以绝后患。
然，水墨主宰常年在外或者闭关修炼，禁卫军执法队由这些顽固派长期掌管，而这些禁卫军执法队根本就不认识帝子云，他们只是听闻过帝子云名头或者看过画像，云帝击杀兽潮离他们很远，就只看见朦朦胧胧身影。
故，在他们心目中，那些老顽固才是掌管他们命运的头领，叫他们对老顽固执法，不是找死？一时之间居然冷场。这简直就是笑话，水星主宰难以置信，真的是颜面扫地。
没想到她长年累月在天外抗击逆神天庭伪神与魔神军，居然主宰权力被这些老顽固架空？忍无可忍便无需再忍，召唤水系神通法术霎那间宛若水浪一波波翻涌扩散，同为水系的新进神格根本难以招架。
水系大神级神通法术宛如一波波水浪扩散的浪花朵朵杀神杀魂，一波神通法术便制服一切违抗主宰令的老顽固，其他宵小之辈见状霎那间五体投地跪拜，自古以来，唯有武力直接有效。
~~~这次帝子云率领的联合舰队便有无敌帮好几个老面孔，或许红叶女神有意让他们之间的元老级相聚，故而从各个战场召回随帝子云出征。
只是人命如天，军情紧急，他们在帝子云调兵遣将发号施令时才赶到舰队，帝子云下达命令后便直赴水星皇城，没有来得及唠嗑。

而这些年他们皆早已成神，已经经历雷罚正神很久的朱武论牛逼哄哄，对付这些入侵魔物魔兽低级伪神如同砍瓜切菜；
“水星大陆真乃菜鸡啊，区区魔兽潮便险些葬送整个水系，还得俺老朱出马，一个顶俩，大哥，是吧。”
朱武论本就是小妖孽级，只是与帝子云一起时，被帝子云逆天妖孽光芒掩盖，关键帝子云还英俊无敌帅，受八方抬爱。这些年老虎不在正是他锋芒毕露，风头正盛之时。
“二弟，你离本神远一些，不要在本神面前晃来晃去，好好研究你的欢喜神殿去。”。司马相儒觉得这些年被朱武论拉低了智商，方才堪堪正神。
“大哥，咋滴了？帝后，俺们都成为神级，小弟应该刮目相看了吧？没想到小弟这些年懒惰了，好死不活才化境。哦，不过本欢喜神感应到小弟突破伪神境了。小弟这么这些年又开始努力，难道看到我们皆是神级了？”
金欣萱，原金星帝女天骄，乃帝子云刚册封帝子便封为帝子妃之一的后宫之主之一，如今更是大神级女神，美的清新脱俗又清纯，一个美的惊心动魄女神白眼；
“好你个猪头，叫夫君云小弟就算了，竟然怀疑夫君云强悍。若不是本女神帮你应付雷罚，你已经又死翘翘魂归地府，看本女神甩尔一个紫金兰花指，我弹”
历经数载，有了此等龙汉帝国无敌帮光明铁骑核心神帅神将助阵，联合舰队很快便把水星大陆的魔物魔兽几乎剿灭。
而这几年帝子云与剑锏法器又仿佛独行侠，无尽杀戮于水星大陆逆神天庭伪神和魔物魔兽最强最密集之地。数载无尽杀戮吞噬，在杀伐中一举突破十七连天级，晋升雷境【雷击境】。
雷击境乃成神尤为坚实一大步，故，接受雷发。雷发成功，可称为半神或新神。在帝子云无尽杀戮吞噬突破雷击境的一刹那，他只感受身心更加空灵，身体更加轻盈。
同时与八荒六合九洲四海更加契合，仿佛连为一体。与大地心心相连，与海洋心有灵犀，与天空紧密相辅，任何神通法术神术更加法力无边，有些神通仙术有了问鼎望极奥义闪烁。
整个庞大的古玄世界乌云密布，厚厚的云层在酝酿前所未有风暴电闪雷鸣。八荒六合，九洲四海，整个大地皆在震动。
剑锏法器乃过来人，哦，应该是过来帝尊级主战兵器；
“云帝，快，飞升天外接受雷发，不要殃及万族···
content_en:
In the Imperial City of the Water System, the concubines of Emperor Yun, Shui Yanran and Shui Yanrou, the former daughters of the Mercury Emperor, cooperated with the Emperor Yun's decree and the ink master's oral instructions, and led the troops by example.
Some of the princes and nobles also accepted the order and led troops to fight.
And some princes and nobles still imagined that before the integration, they could cover the sky with one hand, be high and get something for nothing, and enjoy the feast of wine and meat in the wealthy family every night. Some old fogies are just making fun of themselves, smiling but not smiling;
"Emperor Yun led troops to rescue the Mercury Continent, and we welcome him. However, Emperor Yun knows that this was once the capital of Mercury, and it was on an equal footing with the imperial capital of the Longhan Empire.
The honorific title of Emperor Yun is given by me. We are all princes and nobles with the Mercury star. We should sit in the palace and care about the people of the world. The world must have a core layer of strategists. If we were forcibly sent to fight with demons, I believe all races would not allow it. "
Emperor Yun Jian frowned and raised his eyebrows, "Wanzu won't allow you to go into battle to kill the enemy?" The current ruler of the Longhan Empire, Emperor Xuande, and the former ruler Zhenghong of Venus, who is as powerful as Emperor Xuande, are all fighting in the sky with the strongest army of demons and the false gods of the Anti-God Heaven. Where can you rank?
And the owner’s face needs to be given by you? Di Ziyun did not respond, not wanting to waste time with people who were greedy for life and fearful of death. If these people who are enjoying their success encounter a stronger counter-god, the False God of Heaven, they may fall to their knees in an instant. Look at the ink master. The master of ink and wash understands his mind, and Emperor Ziyun thinks that he is preparing to clean up the interior of Chao Gang;
"Emperor Shui Wuying, now that the demon army is approaching, perhaps the emperor didn't know before because he didn't experience the divine calamity. However, all you need to know is that there are no unbroken eggs under the nest, and you are a new god. Do you know that the god-level magic power is slowly declining in these days?
The Divine Tribulation is the transformation of the Tao to the divine level. Whether you fight or not, the counterfeit gods from the Heavenly Court will come to harvest all the races in the universe so that they can survive the Divine Tribulation safely. There is still a glimmer of hope in your war. If you don't join hands with the Longhan Empire to resist foreign enemies, it will only be regarded as rebellion. "
As the former ruler of Mercury, Shu Mo turned a blind eye to many princes and nobles. However, when the divine calamity comes, only by using heavy codes in troubled times, otherwise evil will breed and spread. Part of them saw that Shui Mo was trying to protect the majesty of Emperor Ziyun, so he hurriedly followed the order and left in a hurry. Hitting the edge of the knife is what a fool does.
However, there are still many people who have relied on ink painting to convince people with their virtues, without doing anything excessive and remaining unmoved. Moreover, hatred for Di Ziyun flashed between his brows. However, their wolfish ambitions cannot escape Di Ziyun and Ink Master.
The master of ink and wash only felt that these guys seriously challenged her majesty and lost face to the future emperor of the Longhan Celestial Dynasty, Emperor Yun. These fish and meat people who are greedy for pleasure and afraid of death are really the scum of the water system.
If they really want to go to heaven to fight with the great gods, they will definitely turn their spearhead and fight against the world. After all, they believe that the heaven and the demon realm are the invincible terrors, while the human world is relatively easy to bully.
"Where is the law enforcement team of the Imperial Guard? Pull out all the remaining people and behead them!". When employing people, the majesty of the master of ink and wash was seriously challenged. He couldn't move and could only use heavy codes to avoid future troubles.
However, the Master of Ink Painting has been away all year round or practicing in seclusion, and the Imperial Guard Law Enforcement Team has been in charge of these die-hards for a long time. These Imperial Guard Law Enforcement Team do not know Di Ziyun at all. They have only heard of Di Ziyun's name or seen his portrait. Emperor Yun killed the beast wave far away from them, and only saw the hazy figure.
Therefore, in their minds, those die-hards are the leaders in charge of their destiny. Are they not seeking death by asking them to enforce the law against the die-hards? Suddenly it was quiet. This is simply a joke. The ruler of Mercury is unbelievable and really loses his face.
Unexpectedly, she has been fighting against the counter-gods of the Heavenly Court and the demon army for many years, but her power to dominate is actually being vacated by these old stubborns? If you can't bear it anymore, you don't need to bear it any more. Summoning the magical power of the water system is like a wave of water spreading in an instant. The new godhead who is also a water system is simply unable to resist.
water systemGod-level magical spells are like waves of spray spreading out, killing gods and souls. A wave of magical spells subdues all the stubborn ones who disobey the Lord's orders. When other young people see this, they immediately fall to the ground and kneel in worship. Since ancient times, only force is directly effective.
~~~This time the combined fleet led by Di Ziyun included several old faces from the Invincible Gang. Perhaps the Red Leaf Goddess intended to bring their elders together, so she recalled them from various battlefields to accompany Di Ziyun.
However, life was at stake and the military situation was urgent. They arrived at the fleet only when Di Ziyun dispatched troops and generals to give orders. After Di Ziyun issued the order, he went straight to Mercury Imperial City without having time to chat.
And in these years, they have all become gods. Zhu Wu, who has experienced thunder and punishment for a long time, is awesome and coaxing. Dealing with these invading monsters and low-level false gods is like chopping melons and vegetables;
"Mercury Continent is really a noob. A mere wave of monsters almost wiped out the entire water system. It's up to me, Old Zhu, to take action. One of them can stand up to the other two, big brother, right?"
Zhu Wulun was originally a little monster, but when he was with Emperor Ziyun, he was overshadowed by Emperor Ziyun's evil light. The key point is that Emperor Ziyun is still handsome and invincible, and is loved by all directions. The absence of Tiger in these years was the time when he showed his talents and was in the limelight.
"Second brother, stay away from me. Don't hang around in front of me. Study your Temple of Joy." Sima Xiangru felt that his IQ had been lowered by Zhu Wulun over the years, and he had just become a righteous god.
"Brother, what's wrong? Empress, we have all become gods. I must be impressed, right? I didn't expect that I have been lazy these years, and it was hard to live until I reached the realm. Oh, but this God of Joy sensed that I have broken through to the pseudo-god realm. I have started working hard again in these years. Did I see that we are all god-level?"
Jin Xinxuan, the original daughter of the Venus Emperor, was one of the masters of the harem who was named one of the emperor's concubines as soon as the emperor's son was enthroned. Now she is a great goddess. Her beauty is fresh, refined and pure, and she is a breathtaking goddess with eye-rolling eyes;
"You are a pig, you can just call me my husband Yun, but you actually doubt your husband Yun's strength. If this goddess hadn't helped you deal with the thunder punishment, you would have died and returned to the underworld. Watch this goddess throw you a purple gold orchid finger, I'll play."
After several years, with the help of the invincible Longhan Empire's core marshals and generals of the Light Cavalry, the combined fleet quickly wiped out almost all the monsters and monsters on the Mercury Continent.
In the past few years, Emperor Ziyun and his sword and magic weapon have been like lone rangers, killing endlessly in the Mercury Continent where the anti-gods, false gods and monsters are the strongest and densest. After several years of endless killing and devouring, he broke through the Seventeenth Level in one fell swoop and was promoted to the Thunder Realm [Thunder Strike Realm].
Reaching the lightning strike realm is a particularly solid step towards becoming a god, so accept the thunder strike. If the thunder is successful, it can be called a demigod or a new god. At the moment when Di Ziyun's endless killing and devouring broke through the lightning strike realm, he only felt that his body and mind became more ethereal and his body became lighter.
At the same time, it is more consistent with the Eight Wastelands, Liuhe, Nine Continents and Four Seas, as if they are connected into one. Connected to the heart of the earth, connected to the heart of the ocean, and closely complementary to the sky, any magical power and magic is more powerful, and some magical powers and magic have the ultimate meaning of aspiration.
The entire vast ancient mysterious world is covered with dark clouds, and the thick clouds are brewing an unprecedented storm with lightning, lightning, and thunder. The whole earth in the eight wastelands and six places, nine continents and four seas is shaking.
The sword and mace weapon is from someone who came here, oh, it should be an emperor-level main battle weapon;
"Yun Emperor, hurry up, fly up to the sky and receive the thunder, don't bring disaster to all races..."
